declaration.statement: Candidate evidence for one exact CRI-O 1.34.0 to 1.35.0 ArtifactStore named-reference plan: the target rejects a short artifact reference and admits a fully-qualified reference through its parser.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, exact spans, attribution and semantic scope require independent review.
The check reads one caller-supplied native CRI ImageStatusRequest JSON file and caller-declared named-reference-resolution intent; it does not observe target request routing or store state.
Only the documented strict explicit-tag short and fully-qualified lexical subsets are classified; other well-formed forms remain UNKNOWN.

PASS clears only the target short-name guard. It does not establish alias resolution, store contents, registry access, ImageStatus results, pulls, removal, runtime behavior or whole-upgrade compatibility.
This packet does not establish signing, publication, support for other versions, or official registry provenance.

attribution.attribution: Bounded excerpts and immutable references to upstream CRI-O source and vendored parser source; attribution and licensing require independent review.
